hook: Ashish Vaswani grew up partly in Oman before his family moved to Nagpur, India, when he was fifteen. He earned a bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra, worked briefly as a computer engineer in Delhi, then completed a master's degree and a PhD in computer science at the University of Southern California. He spent more than six years as a research scientist at Google Brain, and in 2017 he led the eight-author team, including Niki Parmar and Aidan Gomez, that published Attention Is All You Need, introducing the Transformer architecture that replaced recurrence and convolution with self-attention and became the base design for most later large language models. In April 2022 he co-founded Adept AI as chief scientist alongside Niki Parmar and David Luan, before leaving to co-found Essential AI with Parmar, where he now serves as CEO.
name: Ashish Vaswani

quote.text: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
quote.context: From the abstract of Attention Is All You Need, arXiv, submitted June 2017, co-authored with seven others including Niki Parmar and Aidan Gomez
